name: CreteXtract Chloride Da Validation
description: Validation rules for the 12-study primary corpus for chloride diffusion coefficient (Da).

rules.name: Da Valid Range Warning
rules.description: Da > 30 x 10^-12 m2/s is outside the analysis range, flags for Analysis_Eligible = No.

rules.name: Da Positivity
rules.description: Da must be a positive numeric value.

rules.name: Exposure Duration Requirement
rules.description: Exposure_Duration must be extracted as a positive number of days. Exposure time, not total age.

rules.name: Valid w_b_ratio
rules.description: Water-to-binder ratio should be within a reasonable concrete mixing range.

rules.name: Optional Compressive Strength
rules.description: CS is optional, but if present must be evaluated as missingness or a positive numeric value, not zero.

rules.name: Test Method Presence
rules.description: Test_Method is a key matching field and cannot be empty.

rules.name: Cement Quantity Required
rules.description: Cement quantity must be greater than zero.

rules.name: Exposure Temperature Validity
rules.description: Exposure_Temperature, if provided, should be a reasonable value in degrees Celsius.

rules.name: Reference Presence
rules.description: Reference (Study ID) must be populated for one-to-one matching.
